verdicts.reason: A uses the skyscraper well with a large stacked headline and a clear CTA, but it is cramped. The logo is tiny, the sale banner is jammed under it, the legal text is almost as big as the subhead and sits against the bottom edge, and the CTA has no room around it. B shrinks everything: the headline is small with 'last' left alone on its own line, and the logo, subhead, CTA label and legal text are too small to read at this size. It also leaves big dead areas, and the sale ribbon nearly touches both side edges.
